description: Classifies each Skill's eventual distribution tier for the deferred public/private split described in docs/future/PUBLIC_PRIVATE_PACKAGE_SPLIT.md. This is a label-only ledger: it does not move files, change packaging, or affect the current single-repository install in any way. Its only purpose is to keep an always-current answer to 'which side does this Skill go on' so the eventual split reads from a maintained source of truth instead of requiring a fresh audit of all Skills at that time. Update this file whenever a Skill is added, renamed, or its distribution intent changes -- do not let it go stale the way a one-time audit would.

tiers.core: Public CloudBox Core: ordinary software-development Skills (architecture, design, implementation, review, quality, documents, lifecycle, agent-product engineering, and generalized/sanitized domain-engineering knowledge with no company/project/customer identifiers). Dual-published going forward once the split executes, same pattern already used for teach-while-building.
tiers.evolution-pack: Private CloudBox Evolution Pack only: Skill self-development/mining/evolution machinery, the runtime-eval harness used to maintain CloudBox's own routing accuracy, and any future cloudbox-agent-* multi-role persona work. Never published to the public repository.

decisions.decision: semiconductor-equipment-domain-knowledge, equipment-control-architecture, and equipment-domain-modeling classified core, not evolution-pack.
decisions.reasoning: Content is already generalized/de-identified (no specific company, project, customer, recipe, or safety-limit identifiers per developing-skills' own sanitization discipline) -- publishing general equipment-automation-architecture knowledge does not expose the user's specific employer or project work.
decisions.decided_by: user, explicit choice between two presented options

decisions.decision: developing-skills, local-runtime-eval-debugging, and runtime-evaluation-engineering classified evolution-pack.
decisions.reasoning: These are meta-tooling for maintaining CloudBox's own routing/behavior accuracy and skill-development lifecycle, not skills a user would apply to build their own product -- self-referential rather than general-purpose.
decisions.decided_by: Claude, following the category boundary the user already stated (skill self-evolution/mining machinery stays private)

decisions.decision: using-cloudbox-skills classified core, with a caveat.
decisions.reasoning: The router itself is general-purpose and belongs in Core, but a Core-only build must not let it route to evolution-pack-tier skills (dead-end routes on the public side, same class of concern skill-portability.json already flags for local-runtime-eval-debugging on sandboxed surfaces). Needs a Core-scoped routing reference at actual split time, not resolved by this ledger alone.
